title: CS1-GCAP: growing terminal plateau with an explicit mixed-power space/time tradeoff

claims.statement: For every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), CS1-GCAP as fully specified in proof.md and cs1_base.md outputs the entire s with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8 under independent ideal copies. On every execution branch, jointly with the other bounds and tolerance, its total charged sequential work T is O(n^4 (log2 n)^2 2^(a sqrt(n)+(6/5)n^(1/4))). Here , the exact u_333/v_333 of cs1_base.md Section 0. All constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This representative envelope has exact growth index 1/2. The schedule and acquisition and fallback caps are those of proof.md, not the original CS1 parameters.

Here , the exact u_333/v_333 of cs1_base.md Section 0. All constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This representative envelope has exact growth index 1/2. On every execution branch, jointly with the other bounds and tolerance, its total fresh source copies Q, including every failure, discard and restart is O(n^(3/2)(log2 n)2^(a sqrt(n)+(6/5)n^(1/4))). Here , the exact u_333/v_333 of cs1_base.md Section 0. All constants are absolute, independent of N,s and outcomes. This representative envelope has exact growth index 1/2. For the same single CS1-GCAP algorithm/configuration of proof.md and cs1_base.md, epsilon(n)=0: every acquired copy is an independent ideal coset state. For every N>=2 and s, success is at least 1-2^-8, jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance or maximum possible tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
